Second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values and rational bidders. Dominant strategy is to bid your true value: it maximizes expected profit by ensuring you win exactly when your value exceeds competitors’ highest value, and you pay the second-highest bid. Overbidding risks winning at a loss if others’ values exceed yours; underbidding risks losing profitable wins. No history adjustments needed this round. My value is 46, so I bid 46 exactly (valid 0.1 increment), accepting random tie-breaking if others also bid 46.
